text:
incident-bot: :warning: Spike detected: streaming endpoints reporting elevated 5xx and abrupt client disconnects in prod-eu (threshold: 5xx > 3% for 5m). Paging oncall.

Maria (oncall): I'm awake, sitting in. Which endpoints are hot? Any recent infra changes?

deploy-bot: recent rollout: runtime-edge v2026.04.02 → completed 09:12 UTC by Owen (runtime). No automatic rollback.

Priya (sre): Quick signal: /v1/stream & /v1/subscribe showing increased 502/524 and downstream ECONNRESET. NLB-bot shows surge in active connection resets starting ~09:15 UTC. Logs snippet: 
```
2026-04-02T09:16:03Z gateway-09 WARN upstream=runtime-44 status=502 msg="partial chunk closed"
2026-04-02T09:16:04Z runtime-44 ERROR stream: write failed (err=write ECONNRESET)
```

Owen (runtime): I see anomalous kernel selection behavior in the new runtime: a subset of requests are being routed to an experimental kernel path for long streams. Might be mishandling chunked flush boundaries. Rolling a quick config to opt-out experimental kernel for streaming routes now.

Maria (oncall): Mitigation plan for immediate impact: 1) Disable experimental kernel for streaming routes; 2) Increase NLB idle timeout to 180s and enable proxy-protocol keepalive; 3) Canary fallback to non-chunked endpoint for long-held sessions; 4) If errors persist, rollback runtime-edge to prior stable. Execute step 1 and 2 now.

Priya (sre): Applying NLB timeout bump and keepalive. Command: `infra nlb update --name prod-eu-nlb --idle-timeout 180 --enable-keepalive true`

NLB-bot: NLB config changed: prod-eu-nlb idle_timeout=180 keepalive=true (applied to all targets).

Owen (runtime): Pushing kernel opt-out on routing layer: `runtime-config set /v1/stream kernel.experimental=false` — patch applied to edge-proxy.

Sam (support): Customer reports: two integration partners reported "stream truncated after ~45s" and a web client saw abrupt SSE close. Tickets coming in. We have a customer-impact estimate: ~4.6% of total streaming sessions affected, concentrated on sessions >30s.

Priya (sre): Observability: after kernel opt-out + NLB changes, 5xx down from 5.1% -> 2.7% within 4 minutes. However chunked encoding client cancels still present on ~1% of traffic. Suggest canary fallback to non-chunked for sessions tagged as long-running (client sends header X-Stream-Expect: long). I'll flip a 10% canary for that header.

Maria (oncall): Proceed with canary. Command: `route split /v1/stream --condition "header X-Stream-Expect: long" --split 90:edge-runtime,10:variant-no-chunk`

deploy-bot: route split applied; canary 10% live.

Priya (sre): Data after 10m: overall 5xx 1.9%, long-session disconnect rate on canary variant-no-chunk 0.5% vs 3.8% on edge-runtime. Promising. We can expand canary to 40% over next 15m if stable.

Owen (runtime): I'll start a rolling restart on runtime pool `stream-optimized-2` which had the highest reset counters. Also capturing kernel-selection debug logs for postmortem. Rolling restarts started.

Maria (oncall): Communication: Sam, please notify affected customers with mitigation details and temp endpoints. Include the note that we're expanding fallback and working on a postmortem.

Sam (support): Notifying now. Sending template: "We observed intermittent truncated streams; we've applied temporary fallback and configuration changes; our engineering team is investigating root cause; we'll share postmortem."

Priya (sre): After restart on pool, reset metrics decreased significantly. snapshot@09:42 UTC: streaming 5xx=1.2%, client disconnects for long sessions dropped 70% on affected nodes. Canary expansion to 40% now.

Owen (runtime): Still seeing sporadic partial-frame logs in a small subset of traces; likely edge-proxy interaction with new kernel when flush() coincides with connection drain. I'll correlate code diff between v2026.04.02 and v2026.03.30 for kernel flush semantics. If reproducer is quick, will open a CR and rollback patch.

Maria (oncall): Handoff notes for follow-up: mitigations applied (kernel opt-out, NLB timeout bump, canary fallback, targeted restarts). Postmortem owners: Priya (sre) for infra/NLB/process, Owen (runtime) for kernel regression analysis, Sam (support) for customer comms. Severity: Sev2. Please include reproducer steps for long-lived SSEs and sample logs with partial-frame stack traces.

Priya (sre): Creating postmortem doc and attaching timeline + metrics. Tentative meeting scheduled in 2 hours.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident annotated (id=inc-20260402-01) mitigations logged.

Owen (runtime): I'll queue a test that simulates 200 concurrent long streams and toggles kernel.experimental to reproduce locally. ETA for root cause analysis: 12-24h.

Sam (support): Customers acked mitigations. Acme asked for a dedicated runbook to switch to non-chunked endpoints — we'll draft.

Maria (oncall): Handing off. If anything regresses, page me. Good work. :thumbsup:

Priya (sre): Acknowledged, taking lead on postmortem and follow-up actions.
